sentences.en: He claimed that the enormous property was at his disposal.
sentences.zh: 他声称那套庞大的房产任他处理。

sentences.en: My car, such as it is, is at your disposal.
sentences.zh: 我的车勉强可用，任你使用。

sentences.en: Sami didn't want to mess with the garbage disposal anymore.
sentences.zh: 萨米不想再管垃圾处理的事了。

senses.zh: （事情的）处置,（自由）处置权,清理,排列adj.处理（或置放）废品的
